revenue.quote: Total revenue for Q3 2026 was $4.2 billion, up 8 percent year over year, driven by strong demand

guidance.quote: we expect revenue in the range of $4.4 billion to $4.6 billion
We expect full-year 2026 earnings per share between $3.10 and $3.20

risks.description: Supply chain delays in Asia continue to constrain hardware shipments, expected to weigh on fourth quarter results.
Foreign exchange headwinds from a stronger dollar had a modest impact this quarter.
